title: Broadcom DNX ASIC Config
description: Per-ASIC configuration for the Broadcom DNX family. Captures the SOC key formats, core-type handling, always-emitted SDK settings, and declarative tables consumed by BroadcomDnxGenerator.

asic.description: ASIC chip identifier. Must match the basename of this JSON file.

config_type.description: AsicConfigType enum value. DNX configs are key-value SOC property maps carried in AsicConfigEntry.config.

asic_suffix.description: SOC key suffix appended to generated keys (e.g. BCM8889X for Jericho3).

additional_asic_suffixes.description: Further SOC key suffixes appearing in this ASIC's settings data, for example BCM8889X_ADAPTER. Listed for documentation and validation; settings data carries these suffixes inline.

num_lanes_per_core.description: Number of serdes lanes per core. Used to flatten (core_id, core_lane) into the SOC lane number as core_id * num_lanes_per_core + core_lane.

core_types.description: Core types (platform_mapping_v2 CoreType enum names) whose connections are traversed for lane and polarity keys, mapped to the key families used when rendering them.

lane_map_family.description: Family token substituted into key_formats.lane_map (e.g. nif, fabric).

polarity_family.description: Family token substituted into key_formats.polarity_rx/tx (e.g. phy, fabric).

key_formats.description: Format strings for the generated wiring keys. Placeholders: {family}, {lane}, {suffix}, {rx}, {tx}.

default_polarity_settings.description: Default polarity keys without a lane number, emitted verbatim after the per-lane polarity keys. Optional.

base_sdk_settings.description: ASIC-wide SDK settings emitted for every platform and variant, regardless of scenario. Keys carry their SOC suffix inline.

declarative_tables.description: Declarative ASIC tables emitted as fixed SOC properties. Optional; ASICs without such tables omit the field.

tm_port_header_map.description: TM port header entries keyed by port-map topology variant. The generator selects dual_stage_3q_2q for dual-stage port configs, default otherwise.

dtm_flow_region_map.description: DTM flow mapping mode regions, expanded to count keys starting at start_region.

conditional_settings.description: Optional ASIC-level conditional settings, evaluated before platform-level ones.
